approved_decisions.R1: One A2 record lineage per accepted A1 handoff version; materially changed handoffs create a new linked lineage.
approved_decisions.R2: Every released A2 JSON revision is immutable and changes create a new record revision.
approved_decisions.R3: The complete accepted A1-to-A2 handoff is embedded as immutable source input.
approved_decisions.R4: The stable schema uses generic field_assessments and the business field list remains in a separate versioned catalogue.
approved_decisions.R5: Each field is modelled as baseline, observations, one proposed resolution, human decision and separate application state.
approved_decisions.R6: A2 evidence uses an A2 namespace and reused A1 evidence remains referenced as A1 evidence.
approved_decisions.R7: The record supports field-level and record-level review; protected-field changes require explicit field-level approval.
approved_decisions.R8: The record stores requalification signals, requalification returns and authoritative A1 score-revision references while A1 owns scoring.
approved_decisions.R9: External-system IDs are nullable and connector-controlled; null never means checked, absent or eligible.

not_approved: detailed field dictionary and exact enums
source, provider, confidence, freshness and conflict policies
